svg.text: Working window 365 days; archive retention 7 years (2,557 days) time-based WORM, geo-redundant. Controls: AU-2, AU-3, AU-8, AU-9, AU-11; ISO A.8.15, A.8.17; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e).
